messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: geom_area help
parts:
Hi, this my first attempt at creating an area chart
       Consider this small dataset. I want to plot an area graph using geom_area
       but can't get it right. The graphic should look like the attached "sample_graph.png"
       
       but instead the code below creates something like the attached "area1.jpeg" graph
       
    I can create the table next to "sample_graph.png" but I am having trouble positioning the labels at each year
    and the area plots at the wrong value along the Y axis.
      
x <- structure(list(Plot = structure(c(5L, 5L, 5L, 5L), .Label = c("220.5R",
"233R", "305.5R", "309L", "324R", "338L", "391L", "455R"), class = "factor"),
    Year = 2010:2013, Small_Density = c(0.090909091, 0.053571429,
    0.076923077, 0.1), Large_Density = c(0.045454545, 0.053571429,
    0.030769231, 0.083333333)), .Names = c("Plot", "Year", "Small_Density",
"Large_Density"), class = "data.frame", row.names = 9:12)
x

 m <- melt(x,id=c(1:2));m
ggplot(m,aes(Year,value,fill=variable)) + geom_area(position='stack') +
geom_line() +  geom_point() +
geom_text(data=mleaf,aes(label = round(mleaf$value,4)),vjust=-1,colour="blue",size=3)

I also tried geom_line(position='stack') but does not work.

messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: Re: geom_area help
parts:
Hey Felipe,

You just need to specify position="stack" for both the geom_point and geom_line calls:

ggplot(m,aes(Year,value,fill=variable)) +
geom_area(position="stack") +

geom_line(position="stack") +  
geom_point(position="stack")




Adam Loveland
